title: Post-boolean contour node editing commands + appendNode corruption guard
outcome: Boolean-result vectors (contours-authoritative) become editable at the node level through contour-addressed bus commands (move/insert/delete node, close contour), and the legacy appendNode path refuses to corrupt contours-authoritative layers, with derived inverses so every operation undoes exactly.
before: Gap audit 2026-08-27 (main 14e2812): since v6, contours[] is authoritative when present (types.ts:227-247) and boolean results are born nodes:[] (boolean-ops.ts:325); the only vector mutation commands are path.appendNode and path.close (ui-commands.ts:418-434), both legacy-nodes-only; appendPathNode (ops.ts:505-535) recomputes transform from layer.nodes alone, so appending to a boolean layer rewrites x/y and crushes w/h while the renderer keeps drawing untouched contours at the new origin (teleport corruption); validation does not catch it (single-contour branch only, factory.ts:1127); the pen tool appends only to open legacy paths (src/app.ts:933-935).
after: Contour-addressed commands (layerId, contourIndex, nodeIndex) mutate the authoritative topology with pixel-diff-provable effects and exact undo; appending legacy nodes to a contours-authoritative layer raises a clear CommandError instead of corrupting placement.
acceptance: path.moveNode on a boolean-result contour changes canvas output by exactly the node delta (pixel-diff evidence); undo/redo restore exactly.
path.insertNode and path.deleteNode preserve the remaining geometry byte-identically apart from the edited contour.
appendPathNode on a contours-authoritative layer is rejected with a clear CommandError (or correctly routed to the authoritative contour) - never a transform rewrite.
validateDocument stays green across all operations; save/reopen round-trips the edited contours.
npx tsc --noEmit, targeted tests, npm run test:unit baseline, npm run build pass.
evidence: Pixel-diff proof for moveNode on a boolean ring contour
Corruption-guard rejection test for appendNode on contours layer

delta.before: Boolean output geometry is immutable via commands; appendNode actively corrupts placement.
delta.after: Contour-addressed node editing with exact inverses and a corruption guard.
regression_protection: Existing boolean-ops and ui-commands suites green
delta.new_debt: Overlay handle-picking (compositor) deferred to a coordinated phase 2 packet.
